title: archimedean_theta: polynomial-time computation of Poincaré theta series of classical Schottky groups
description: Sage code accompanying the article "A polynomial-time algorithm to compute theta functions of Schottky groups": Abelian integrals, holomorphic differentials, period matrices and the Schottky-Klein prime function of classical Schottky groups to hundreds of digits, with the scripts behind the examples and benchmarks of the paper.
